thread:
jess: PR #423 merged. Heads-up: SDK v2.1 changed resume_token to a base64-encoded JSON blob. Our examples still show the old plain string. Can we push small py/ts/go snippet updates for streaming resume + a short retry pattern?

ben: Ill take TS. Ill add a compact async-iterator example and a tiny decode helper with a comment that says 'prefer SDK helper in prod'.

li: Ill do Python. Plan: encode_resume/decode_resume helpers and an idempotent_retry decorator that sets X-Request-Id and uses exponential backoff for ConnectionError/Timeout and 5xx. Keep the snippets testable.

nora: Go example from me: ResumeToken struct (json tags), channel-based stream loop, save token when present. Will add README under examples/stream-resume.

jess: Two editorial asks: 1) migration blurb: "v2.1 changed resume_token to base64(JSON); use SDK helpers to avoid parsing in prod." 2) security note: "Do not persist raw resume tokens to public logs; they may contain identifiers."

docs-bot: Reminder: run docs/lint and docs/snippet-check before merge. Tag PRs with `docs:snippets`.

ben: Will open TS PR and run snippet-check locally.

li: Python PR incoming with unit tests for encode/decode.

nora: Go PR will land shortly.

jess: Thanks all — ping when CI is green and Ill add the migration callout to the live docs. :rocket:
